about_the_game:
"Nowhere to Run" is an action/adventure interactive film, packed with choices that actually matter. 

In the demo you'll be following Bob, a local police officer - will you be able to uncover the truth about Daniel? Or are you going to stay his friend? 

Three endings to uncover, one of them hidden - will you be able to find them all?

In this high stakes, non-linear independent film you decide what happens next.

Nowhere to Run is a film written and directed by Piotr Matyja, starring Kirsten Schaffer, Hunt Mallory, Sara Gellert, Jennifer Collins and Michael Profunato. 

Point System

Throughout the game you will interact with multiple characters and your choices will impact the relationships with them.

Features

• Live action interactive film.
• Timed choices, mini games and hidden features.
• Point System that influences the story as you play.

• Skip Scene button and Story Map representing the choices you've made.
